36	func NewCmdView(f *cmdutil.Factory, runF func(*ViewOptions) error) *cobra.Command {
37		opts := &ViewOptions{
38			IO:         f.IOStreams,
39			HttpClient: f.HttpClient,
40			Browser:    f.Browser,
41			Prompter:   f.Prompter,
42		}
43	
44		cmd := &cobra.Command{
45			Use:   "view [<ruleset-id>]",
46			Short: "View information about a ruleset",
47			Long: heredoc.Doc(`
48				View information about a GitHub ruleset.
49	
50				If no ID is provided, an interactive prompt will be used to choose
51				the ruleset to view.
52				
53				Use the --parents flag to control whether rulesets configured at higher
54				levels that also apply to the provided repository or organization should
55				be returned. The default is true.
56			`),
57			Example: heredoc.Doc(`
58				# Interactively choose a ruleset to view from all rulesets that apply to the current repository
59				$ gh ruleset view
60	
61				# Interactively choose a ruleset to view from only rulesets configured in the current repository
62				$ gh ruleset view --no-parents
63	
64				# View a ruleset configured in the current repository or any of its parents
65				$ gh ruleset view 43
66	
67				# View a ruleset configured in a different repository or any of its parents
68				$ gh ruleset view 23 --repo owner/repo
69	
70				# View an organization-level ruleset
71				$ gh ruleset view 23 --org my-org
72			`),
73			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
74			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
75				if repoOverride, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("repo"); repoOverride != "" && opts.Organization != "" {
76					return cmdutil.FlagErrorf("only one of --repo and --org may be specified")
77				}
78	
79				// support `-R, --repo` override
80				opts.BaseRepo = f.BaseRepo
81	
82				if len(args) > 0 {
83					// a string is actually needed later on, so verify that it's numeric
84					// but use the string anyway
85					_, err := strconv.Atoi(args[0])
86					if err != nil {
87						return cmdutil.FlagErrorf("invalid value for ruleset ID: %v is not an integer", args[0])
88					}
89					opts.ID = args[0]
90				} else if !opts.IO.CanPrompt() {
91					return cmdutil.FlagErrorf("a ruleset ID must be provided when not running interactively")
92				} else {
93					opts.InteractiveMode = true
94				}
95	
96				if runF != nil {
97					return runF(opts)
98				}
99				return viewRun(opts)
100			},
101		}

104		cmd.Flags().StringVarP(&opts.Organization, "org", "o", "", "Organization name if the provided ID is an organization-level ruleset")
105		cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&opts.IncludeParents, "parents", "p", true, "Whether to include rulesets configured at higher levels that also apply")

110	func viewRun(opts *ViewOptions) error {
111		httpClient, err := opts.HttpClient()
112		if err != nil {
113			return err
114		}
115	
116		repoI, err := opts.BaseRepo()
117		if err != nil {
118			return err
119		}
120	
121		hostname, _ := ghAuth.DefaultHost()
122		cs := opts.IO.ColorScheme()
123	
124		if opts.InteractiveMode {
125			var rsList *shared.RulesetList
126			limit := 30
127			if opts.Organization != "" {
128				rsList, err = shared.ListOrgRulesets(httpClient, opts.Organization, limit, hostname, opts.IncludeParents)
129			} else {
130				rsList, err = shared.ListRepoRulesets(httpClient, repoI, limit, opts.IncludeParents)
131			}
132	
133			if err != nil {
134				return err
135			}
136	
137			if rsList.TotalCount == 0 {
138				return shared.NoRulesetsFoundError(opts.Organization, repoI, opts.IncludeParents)
139			}
140	
141			rs, err := selectRulesetID(rsList, opts.Prompter, cs)
142			if err != nil {
143				return err
144			}
145	
146			if rs != nil {
147				opts.ID = strconv.Itoa(rs.DatabaseId)
148	
149				// can't get a ruleset lower in the chain than what was queried, so no need to handle repos here
150				if rs.Source.TypeName == "Organization" {
151					opts.Organization = rs.Source.Owner
152				}
153			}
154		}
155	
156		var rs *shared.RulesetREST
157		if opts.Organization != "" {
158			rs, err = viewOrgRuleset(httpClient, opts.Organization, opts.ID, hostname)
159		} else {
160			rs, err = viewRepoRuleset(httpClient, repoI, opts.ID)
161		}
162	
163		if err != nil {
164			return err
165		}
166	
167		w := opts.IO.Out
168	
169		if opts.WebMode {
170			if rs != nil {
171				if opts.IO.IsStdoutTTY() {
172					fmt.Fprintf(opts.IO.Out, "Opening %s in your browser.\n", text.DisplayURL(rs.Links.Html.Href))
173				}
174	
175				return opts.Browser.Browse(rs.Links.Html.Href)
176			} else {
177				fmt.Fprintf(w, "ruleset not found\n")
178			}
179		}
180	
181		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n%s\n", cs.Bold(rs.Name))
182		fmt.Fprintf(w, "ID: %s\n", cs.Cyan(strconv.Itoa(rs.Id)))
183		fmt.Fprintf(w, "Source: %s (%s)\n", rs.Source, rs.SourceType)
184	
185		fmt.Fprint(w, "Enforcement: ")
186		switch rs.Enforcement {
187		case "disabled":
188			fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\n", cs.Red("Disabled"))
189		case "evaluate":
190			fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\n", cs.Yellow("Evaluate Mode (not enforced)"))
191		case "active":
192			fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\n", cs.Green("Active"))
193		default:
194			fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\n", rs.Enforcement)
195		}
196	
197		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n%s\n", cs.Bold("Bypass List"))
198		if len(rs.BypassActors) == 0 {
199			fmt.Fprintf(w, "This ruleset cannot be bypassed\n")
200		} else {
201			sort.Slice(rs.BypassActors, func(i, j int) bool {
202				return rs.BypassActors[i].ActorId < rs.BypassActors[j].ActorId
203			})
204	
205			for _, t := range rs.BypassActors {
206				fmt.Fprintf(w, "- %s (ID: %d), mode: %s\n", t.ActorType, t.ActorId, t.BypassMode)
207			}
208		}
209	
210		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n%s\n", cs.Bold("Conditions"))
211		if len(rs.Conditions) == 0 {
212			fmt.Fprintf(w, "No conditions configured\n")
213		} else {
214			// sort keys for consistent responses
215			keys := make([]string, 0, len(rs.Conditions))
216			for key := range rs.Conditions {
217				keys = append(keys, key)
218			}
219			sort.Strings(keys)
220	
221			for _, name := range keys {
222				condition := rs.Conditions[name]
223				fmt.Fprintf(w, "- %s: ", name)
224	
225				// sort these keys too for consistency
226				subkeys := make([]string, 0, len(condition))
227				for subkey := range condition {
228					subkeys = append(subkeys, subkey)
229				}
230				sort.Strings(subkeys)
231	
232				for _, n := range subkeys {
233					fmt.Fprintf(w, "[%s: %v] ", n, condition[n])
234				}
235	
236				fmt.Fprint(w, "\n")
237			}
238		}
239	
240		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n%s\n", cs.Bold("Rules"))
241		if len(rs.Rules) == 0 {
242			fmt.Fprintf(w, "No rules configured\n")
243		} else {
244			fmt.Fprint(w, shared.ParseRulesForDisplay(rs.Rules))
245		}
246	
247		return nil
248	}
249	
250	func selectRulesetID(rsList *shared.RulesetList, p prompter.Prompter, cs *iostreams.ColorScheme) (*shared.RulesetGraphQL, error) {
251		rulesets := make([]string, len(rsList.Rulesets))
252		for i, rs := range rsList.Rulesets {
253			s := fmt.Sprintf(
254				"%s: %s | %s | contains %s | configured in %s",
255				cs.Cyan(strconv.Itoa(rs.DatabaseId)),
256				rs.Name,
257				strings.ToLower(rs.Enforcement),
258				text.Pluralize(rs.Rules.TotalCount, "rule"),
259				shared.RulesetSource(rs),
260			)
261			rulesets[i] = s
262		}
263	
264		r, err := p.Select("Which ruleset would you like to view?", rulesets[0], rulesets)
265		if err != nil {
266			return nil, err
267		}
268	
269		return &rsList.Rulesets[r], nil
270	}

22	type ListOptions struct {

34	func NewCmdList(f *cmdutil.Factory, runF func(*ListOptions) error) *cobra.Command {
35		opts := &ListOptions{
36			IO:         f.IOStreams,
37			HttpClient: f.HttpClient,
38			Browser:    f.Browser,
39		}
40		cmd := &cobra.Command{
41			Use:   "list",
42			Short: "List rulesets for a repository or organization",
43			Long: heredoc.Doc(`
44				List GitHub rulesets for a repository or organization.
45	
46				If no options are provided, the current repository's rulesets are listed. You can query a different
47				repository's rulesets by using the --repo flag. You can also use the --org flag to list rulesets
48				configured for the provided organization.
49	
50				Use the --parents flag to control whether rulesets configured at higher levels that also apply to the provided
51				repository or organization should be returned. The default is true.
52				
53				Your access token must have the admin:org scope to use the --org flag, which can be granted by running "gh auth refresh -s admin:org".
54			`),
55			Example: heredoc.Doc(`
56				# List rulesets in the current repository
57				$ gh ruleset list
58	
59				# List rulesets in a different repository, including those configured at higher levels
60				$ gh ruleset list --repo owner/repo --parents
61	
62				# List rulesets in an organization
63				$ gh ruleset list --org org-name
64			`),
65			Args: cobra.ExactArgs(0),
66			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
67				if repoOverride, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("repo"); repoOverride != "" && opts.Organization != "" {
68					return cmdutil.FlagErrorf("only one of --repo and --org may be specified")
69				}
70	
71				// support `-R, --repo` override
72				opts.BaseRepo = f.BaseRepo
73	
74				if opts.Limit < 1 {
75					return cmdutil.FlagErrorf("invalid limit: %v", opts.Limit)
76				}
77	
78				if runF != nil {
79					return runF(opts)
80				}
81	
82				return listRun(opts)
83			},
84		}
85	
86		cmd.Flags().IntVarP(&opts.Limit, "limit", "L", 30, "Maximum number of rulesets to list")
87		cmd.Flags().StringVarP(&opts.Organization, "org", "o", "", "List organization-wide rulesets for the provided organization")
88		cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&opts.IncludeParents, "parents", "p", true, "Whether to include rulesets configured at higher levels that also apply")
89		cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&opts.WebMode, "web", "w", false, "Open the list of rulesets in the web browser")
90	
91		return cmd
92	}
93	
94	func listRun(opts *ListOptions) error {
95		httpClient, err := opts.HttpClient()
96		if err != nil {
97			return err
98		}
99	
100		repoI, err := opts.BaseRepo()
101		if err != nil {
102			return err
103		}
104	
105		hostname, _ := ghAuth.DefaultHost()
106	
107		if opts.WebMode {
108			var rulesetURL string
109			if opts.Organization != "" {
110				rulesetURL = fmt.Sprintf("%sorganizations/%s/settings/rules", ghinstance.HostPrefix(hostname), opts.Organization)
111			} else {
112				rulesetURL = ghrepo.GenerateRepoURL(repoI, "rules")
113			}
114	
115			if opts.IO.IsStdoutTTY() {
116				fmt.Fprintf(opts.IO.Out, "Opening %s in your browser.\n", text.DisplayURL(rulesetURL))
117			}
118	
119			return opts.Browser.Browse(rulesetURL)
120		}
121	
122		var result *shared.RulesetList
123	
124		if opts.Organization != "" {
125			result, err = shared.ListOrgRulesets(httpClient, opts.Organization, opts.Limit, hostname, opts.IncludeParents)
126		} else {
127			result, err = shared.ListRepoRulesets(httpClient, repoI, opts.Limit, opts.IncludeParents)
128		}
129	
130		if err != nil {
131			return err
132		}
133	
134		if result.TotalCount == 0 {
135			return shared.NoRulesetsFoundError(opts.Organization, repoI, opts.IncludeParents)
136		}
137	
138		opts.IO.DetectTerminalTheme()
139		if err := opts.IO.StartPager(); err == nil {
140			defer opts.IO.StopPager()
141		} else {
142			fmt.Fprintf(opts.IO.ErrOut, "failed to start pager: %v\n", err)
143		}
144	
145		cs := opts.IO.ColorScheme()
146	
147		if opts.IO.IsStdoutTTY() {
148			parentsMsg := ""
149			if opts.IncludeParents {
150				parentsMsg = " and its parents"
151			}
152	
153			inMsg := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", shared.EntityName(opts.Organization, repoI), parentsMsg)
154			fmt.Fprintf(opts.IO.Out, "\nShowing %d of %d rulesets in %s\n\n", len(result.Rulesets), result.TotalCount, inMsg)
155		}
156	
157		tp := tableprinter.New(opts.IO)
158		tp.HeaderRow("ID", "NAME", "SOURCE", "STATUS", "RULES")
159	
160		for _, rs := range result.Rulesets {
161			tp.AddField(strconv.Itoa(rs.DatabaseId), tableprinter.WithColor(cs.Cyan))
162			tp.AddField(rs.Name, tableprinter.WithColor(cs.Bold))
163			tp.AddField(shared.RulesetSource(rs))
164			tp.AddField(strings.ToLower(rs.Enforcement))
165			tp.AddField(strconv.Itoa(rs.Rules.TotalCount))
166			tp.EndRow()
167		}
168	
169		return tp.Render()
170	}
